scope: Eight non-destructive Christmas red/blue decor variants. Originals and neutral Christmas assets preserved.

requests.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: bundled photographic architectural background for Notchscape, a dark macOS app. Input image 1 is the exact edit target. Change only the specified small-scale decor/material and accent-lighting colors; preserve the SAME recognizable White House-inspired architecture, camera position, geometry, furniture positions, dusk exposure, realistic natural stone/fabric/wood textures, and exact landscape 16:9 composition. This is an imagined decorative theme, not a documentary claim about any administration. Keep most limestone/ivory, natural wood, evergreen, warm gold light and sky neutral, with realistic reflected accent light only near its source. IMPORTANT: no flat overall red/blue filter or color wash, no repainting the whole facade/walls, no CGI/neon look. Keep a calm dark left and central area for separate UI widgets; key accents/focal detail mainly in right half and central vertical band. No new people, politicians, portraits, official seals, flags, party emblems, text, signage, campaign objects, watermark or embedded UI. Do not move, zoom or crop the base framing. Accent version: Republican red/burgundy Christmas decorative art. On this exact snowy Christmas exterior, recolor only EXISTING ribbons and bows on the portico garlands, roofline garlands, wreaths, and the Christmas tree at the far right, plus a minority of existing tree baubles, to rich restrained burgundy-red velvet and lacquer, visibly red decor accents; preserve the majority of ornaments as warm gold/ivory. Add only very subtle localized warm ruby-red portico-base uplighting in the right half, with realistic low-output reflected color limited near the columns' bases. Preserve neutral pale limestone, warm white window and holiday lights, all snow-covered ground/roofs/branches, every visible falling snowflake, tree and garland positions, unaltered blue dusk sky, and the exact wide framing. Snow stays natural white; no overall color cast. Preserve landscape 16:9 at the original 1672x940 size, with no zoom or crop.

visual_inspection.notes: Same exterior geometry, framing, tree/garland placements, warm white majority lighting, neutral snow and dusk sky retained. Red or blue bows/baubles and localized low portico-base light are visible; left and center remain calm. No people, text, logos, seals, flags, or UI.
